tei:titleStmt.tei:title: mgon po'i tshogs mchod zur 'khol bzhugs/tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/oṃ ā bighnānta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā
mgon po'i tshogs mchod zur 'khol bzhugs/tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/oṃ ā bighnānta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā

tei:div.tei:p: mgon po'i tshogs mchod zur 'khol bzhugs/ tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ ā bighnānta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥ sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can chang zung la yaṃ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyis steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍurya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rakta gser gtso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūṃ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ na mo/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/

mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di/ bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ byin brlab kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bla ma rnams bzhengs shig /bka' brgyud bla ma sku bskyod 'tshal// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig yi dam rnams bzhengs shig /rdo rje phag mo sku bskyod 'tshal// o rgyan gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams bzhengs shig /dpal ldan mgon po sku bskyod 'tshal// ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams bzhengs shig /sras mchog nag po sku bskyod 'tshal// las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams bzhengs shig /'jig rten mgon po sku bskyod 'tshal// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams bzhengs shig /dam can rgya mtsho sku bskyod 'tshal// bka' sdod mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig zhing skyong rnams bzhengs shig /ga ya dha ra sku bskyod 'tshal// pho brang mkha' spyod tsā ri nas// bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum la// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin gyis rlobs// tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob// 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ badzra ā tsārya sā pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/

oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ shri dzña na nā tha dzña na ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wa ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ karma na tha karma nā sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ lo ka nā tha lo ka ḍa ki ni sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ sa ma ya nā tha sa ma ya ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ri ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā la sing hā mu kha sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha hi/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya/ tshogs kyi phud gtor mar bran/ bdud rtsi nam mkhar 'bul lo// dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos kyis dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// sras mchog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol// ri rab mchog gi steng shed nas// 'jig rten mgon po gzi brjid can// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol// mthong ba tsam gyis bdud kyi dpung*// kun nas skrag par byed pa yi// ma hā kā la khyod kyi zhal// bdag la de ring bstan du gsol// las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad// skad cig yud gyis 'grub byed pa// sngags kyi dngos grub chen po de'ang*// bdag la de ring stsal du gsol// byams pa'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs// brtse ba'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs// lung bstan rjes su gnang ba yi// bka' stsal bdag la gnang du gsol/ bhyo/ ma cig smin mtshams mdzod spu yi// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// sku yi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma dza// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// ma cig ljags kyi dbang mo yi// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// gsung gi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma dzu// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// ma cig thugs kyi dpal be 'u// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// thugs kyi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la re ma ti sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ siddhi sa ma ya hūṃ āḥhūṃ/

de nas las kyi rdo rjes tshogs phud lag pa g.yas su thabs kyi rdzas bza' ba dang*/ g.yon du shes rab kyi rdzas btung ba 'dzin pas/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma bsnol te dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gus pa dang bcas pas rdo rjes slob dpon gyi drung du/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la rnam rtog byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// zhes drangs la slob dpon gyis kyang*/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral ba// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// ji tsam 'os pa'i phud bzhag la longs spyod cing*/ de nas las kyi rdo rje phud dang lhag ma snod gcig tu bsdus par slob dpon gyi kha bshal ba'i chang gis dran pa bshams shing*/ thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bza' btung sna tshogs kyi phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba u tstshi ṣṭa ba liṃ ta bha kṣa si swā hā/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ sha za mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro pho nya'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shing tshim par mdzod la/ bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa skyong ba dang*/ dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces brjod de rol mo dang bcas pas phyi rol du dor ro// oṃ khrag gi rgya mtsho me tog u pā kṣa// tshil chen bsreg dang mar nag chen po'i me// thal chen khrag zhag bdud rtsi sha chen lnga// dur khrod sgra yis phyogs rnams bkang ste 'bul// oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā la de wī sa pa ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ ḍā ki bye ba 'bum gyis rab btud cing*// bcom ldan rdo rje bde mas yang dag 'khyud// bde chen lhun 'grub go 'phang brnyes// rgyal ba kun yab khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

de nas lhag chad la sogs pa dang dam tshig gi nyes ltung bshags shing bzod par gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ don dam chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i thabs kyis sprul pa'i skur ston cing*// smon lam dbang gis gdug pa'i tshul 'dzin pa// dpal ldan 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// thog med dus nas ma rig dbang gyur pas// mi shes sgrib pa le lo'i dbang gis ni// thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam las 'gal ba rnams// sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// da lta bdag blo dman pa'i dbang gyur te// bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin yan lag ma tshang dang*// gsang sngags grangs nyung log par gyur pa rnams// las kyi mgon po'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// sgo gsum snyom las le lo'i dbang gis ni// dam rdzas ma tshang gtor ma'i phud nyams dang*// 'gal dang nor 'khrul chad lhag gyur pa rnams// 'jig rten pho nya'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// de ltar gsol ba'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// bdag gi nyes pa'i tshogs rnams dag pa dang*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun du bsrung ba dang*// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol/ ༈ bhyo/ rlung nag dgu klong 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor du// dpal gyi bka' sdod nye ba'i snying nye ma// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob khams gsum bdud 'dul ma// dbang phyug lha mo dpon g.yog bdag la dgongs// 'da' bka' rdo rje dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer// yongs su mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid kyang*// klong du ma gyur goms pa'i shugs chung bas// lta ba 'phangs dma' chos nyid don ma rtogs// sgom pa yun thung lha mo'i zhal ma mthong*// snying po grangs nyung grwa chag zur nyams dang*// nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pas gang ba dang*// nyams dang gtam byas kha 'phro bsres pa dang*// khas blangs dam bcas dus las yol ba dang*// dam rdzas ma tshang gtor ma'i phud nyams dang*// sgrub la mi brtson le los g.yengs ba dang*// gsang ba'i man ngag gzhan la spel ba rnams// rab tu 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// mthol lo mthol lo ye shes ma mo'i tshogs// bshags so bshags so 'jig rten pho nya rnams// thugs rje chen pos tshangs par stsal du gsol// oṃ sa ma ya/

āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya kṣa bai ta li hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs dang*/ tshe rabs kun nas rgyal bas dbang bskur cing*/ tshe rabs kun tu bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa'i// mgon po mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo ā kri ni/ na mo yo tri ni/ na mo ta kri ni/ tadya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ki ti tsi ti/ ni ti pa ta ye swā hā/ tshe rabs sngon nas da lta phan chad du// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa// da lta der 'dir bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa yi// phyi nang bar chad thams cad zhi bar shog /smon lam gdab pa ni/ ma 'ongs pa na lung bstan pa// de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba yi// dbang po zhes byar gyur pa'i tshe// gdug cing rtsub pa'i gdul bya rnams// 'dren pa'i zhabs drung skyes nas kyang*// chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /bdag ni mngon par byang chub ste// rang rig ye shes mngon gyur nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung slad du// khyod dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /bkra shis brjod pa ni/ oṃ/ sngon tshe bcom ldan thub pa'i bstan pa la// zhi ba lo legs bkra shis ljang 'khrungs te// rdo rje gdan gyi drung du tshe gsol bas// bdud rtsi spel mdzad dge ba'i lo tog smin// de bzhin deng 'dir bdag kyang bkra shis shog /'jig rten 'di yi bkra shis mchog rab ni// bdag cag lus la rgas rgud mi 'byung zhing*// tshe 'dir bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa yi// dpal dang ldan pa'i bkra shis thob par shog

/'khor ba'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal 'das nas ni// 'og min lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog tu// nges pa'i don mchog man ngag ston pa la// bka' drin can gyi rdo rje slob dpon dang*// lu gu rgyud dang 'brel ba'i mched lcam rnams// dus gsum 'du 'bral med par 'grogs pa dang*// rtag tu skye shi 'pho 'gyur med pa yi// bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog /bdag ni lcam bral thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// 'gyur ba med par lhun gyis grub pa dang*// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' la dbang thob pa'i// 'gro kun dpal du 'gyur ba'i bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'dir yang bkra shis shing*// nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la// mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar kyi li li// nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog /maṅga laṃ siddhi dza ya a la la ho/ dge'o// dge'o/ dge'o// //
